title: apps_catalog.json
description: Authored per-app prose keyed by app_id (plan §2.2, fixes the #1 render-breaker). Consultant-owned. Top-level keys MUST be canonical app_ids from shared/app_registry.json (config_general, crm, ventas, compras, inventario, fabricacion, facturacion, contabilidad, proyecto, helpdesk, website, marketing_email, rrhh) or namespaced extras. 'sesiones' is NUMERIC (no prose regex). display_name/icon/color mirror the registry es values for the es pack.

display_name.description: App display name in this locale.

icon.description: SVG filename under assets/odoo-icons/, e.g. 'mrp.svg'. Shared across locales.

color.description: Hex color; es mirrors registry es_color.

dynapps_core.description: Core-module features; category label from instance.core_module_label.

accounting_from_fiscal.description: contabilidad: pulls chart-of-accounts copy from fiscal.json instead of hardcoding.
